scope: Local validation and execution of exported Code nodes and validation expressions; not an n8n engine run or email delivery test

checks.name: No webhook, external request, model node or credentials
Save is the only successor of record construction; notifications follow Save
All storage uses dedicated sandbox tables
Synthetic inquiry passes actual workflow normalization and validation
Invalid email, short message and honeypot are rejected
HTML and instruction text stay escaped data in the owner preview
Acknowledgement is fixed and contains no deadline, booking or action links
Missing, malformed and low-confidence classifier results route to manual review
Spam classification suppresses the notification branch
Both email previews explicitly report not sent
